title: Count the number of bytes in a file
summary: Use the wc command to count the exact size of a file in bytes. This is useful for checking file sizes without using ls or stat.

steps.explain: Run wc with the --bytes flag followed by the path to your file. This prints the total number of bytes in the file.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file you want to measure in bytes

alternatives.explain: Use the short flag -c instead of --bytes.
